Market.marketDescription: Main market with the largest selection of assets and yield options

CoreAssets.title: Core Assets
CoreAssets.borrowApyTooltip: Variable interest rate will fluctuate based on the market conditions.

MarketBasicInfo.netWorthTooltip: The total value of your supplied assets minus borrowed assets in this market.
MarketBasicInfo.netApyTooltip: The weighted average of your supply and borrow APYs, reflecting your overall earning or cost rate across all positions.

MarketSummary.tooltipTotalMarketSize: The total value of all assets currently deposited into this market. It represents the sum of all supplied collateral and liquidity across every reserve.
MarketSummary.tooltipTotalAvailable: The total liquidity available to be borrowed right now. This is the difference between total supplied assets and currently borrowed assets.
MarketSummary.tooltipTotalBorrowed: The total value of all assets currently borrowed from this market across every reserve.
MarketSummary.tooltipUtilizationRate: The percentage of the total supplied liquidity that is currently being borrowed. Higher utilisation drives borrow rates up and supply rates up via the interest rate model.

ReserveOverview.reserveNotFoundHint: The asset address provided does not match any active reserve.
ReserveOverview.connectWalletToSee: Connect your wallet to see your position
ReserveOverview.noPosition: You have no position in this reserve
ReserveOverview.tooltipMaxLtv: The Maximum LTV ratio represents the maximum borrowing power of a specific collateral. For example, if a collateral has an LTV of 75%, the user can borrow up to 0.75 worth of ETH in the principal currency for every 1 ETH worth of collateral.
ReserveOverview.tooltipLiquidationThreshold: This represents the threshold at which a borrow position will be considered undercollateralized and subject to liquidation for each collateral. For example, if a collateral has a liquidation threshold of 80%, it means that the position will be liquidated when the debt value is worth 80% of the collateral value.
ReserveOverview.tooltipLiquidationPenalty: When a liquidation occurs, liquidators repay up to 50% of the outstanding borrowed amount on behalf of the borrower. In return, they can buy the collateral at a discount and keep the difference (liquidation penalty) as a bonus.
ReserveOverview.tooltipApyVariable: Variable interest rate will fluctuate based on the market conditions.
ReserveOverview.tooltipHealthFactor: Your health factor represents the safety of your position. A value above 1 means your position is safe. Below 1 means you risk liquidation.

ReserveActions.insufficientCollateral: You do not have enough collateral to borrow this amount

Dashboard.title: My Dashboard
Dashboard.subtitle: Overview of your supplies, borrows, and health metrics.
Dashboard.connectWalletDescription: Please connect your wallet to view your portfolio.
Dashboard.netWorthTooltip: Net worth is the difference between your total supplied assets and your total borrowed assets.
Dashboard.netApyTooltip: The weighted net annualised percentage yield across all your positions, factoring in both supply earnings and borrow costs.
Dashboard.healthFactorTooltip: The health factor represents the safety of your loan. Keep it above 1 to avoid liquidation. The higher, the safer.
Dashboard.currentLtvTooltip: Loan-to-Value ratio shows how much you have borrowed relative to your supplied collateral. A higher LTV means more risk.
Dashboard.noSuppliesDescription: You have not supplied any assets yet. Go to a reserve page to start supplying.
Dashboard.noBorrowsDescription: You have not borrowed any assets yet. Go to a reserve page to start borrowing.
Dashboard.cannotUseAsCollateral: This asset cannot be used as collateral
Dashboard.cannotDisableHf: Cannot disable — health factor would drop below 1.0
